notes: attoDRY2100 with the optional 9 T solenoid and the Basic Measurement Insert (art. 1007005). Pulse-tube closed-cycle magneto-optical cryostat, 1.65-300 K automated, base 1.65-1.8 K for standard inserts, stability < ±10 mK guaranteed (1.5-10 K), > 1 mW at 2 K at the sample, full 9 T available at 300 K, initial cooldown 20-24 h incl. 9 T magnet, sample cooldown 3-5 h. Sample sits in He exchange gas inside a top-loading probe bore (49 mm / 49.7 mm per brochure); optical access only via the insert's single 25 mm uncoated fused-silica top window. Pulse-tube identification is explicit on the product page ('mechanical vibrations created by the pulse-tube coldhead are decoupled'), but no cold-head model or valve frequency is published for this model, so the rate is omitted.
